methods.name: International wire
methods.desc: Your bank sends it through correspondent banks. Cheap, but the money crosses several banks and takes days to land.

methods.name: Letter of credit (Nexus Bank)
methods.requires_text: needs a Nexus Bank business account
methods.desc: Nexus Bank guarantees the payment to the supplier's bank. They ship on the bank's word in about 2 days.

methods.name: Digital dollars (stablecoin, simulated)
methods.requires_text: needs a verified exchange account (ask Lina Zhao at Nexus Bank)
methods.desc: A licensed exchange turns your dollars into digital dollars and sends them in minutes. You carry the platform's risk.

methods.name: Escrow on delivery (smart contract, simulated)
methods.requires_text: needs an escrow account (ask Lina Zhao at Nexus Bank)
methods.desc: Your money is locked in a contract that pays the supplier only when the goods arrive. Refunded if they never do. Small fee, no wire delay.
